description: Add physical cards to the collection (bulk). Each item is a card reference (scryfall_id, or name [+ set_code, collector_number]) plus holding attributes. quantity ≥ 1 identical copies form one stack. Defaults: finish nonfoil, condition NM, lang en, origin "single", location "Unsorted" (created if missing; any unknown location name is auto-created). purchase_price is PER CARD in purchase_currency (USD/EUR/CHF). Unresolvable names are returned under "unresolved", the rest are added. A set_code (and collector_number) names one printing: an item whose card is not there comes back under "unresolved", naming the nearest printing. The list is added in one write: an item the collection refuses (an origin printed_proxy or bought_proxy with is_proxy false, a blank location) refuses the whole call and nothing is added. A name that is no card's exact name was added as Scryfall's closest match, and a name in another language as its English card: each is listed under "inexact" with the card it became (matched_by fuzzy or other_language). Tell the user which card was added for each fuzzy one. From a photo of cards, every name, set and finish is your own reading: list them and get the user's yes before adding.

items.description: Max 75 items per call (Scryfall batch limit). Send the whole list in one call: it is resolved in one batch.

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

origin.description: How the card was acquired (mutually exclusive). printed_proxy/bought_proxy force is_proxy=true. is_proxy/is_signed/is_altered are independent flags that combine freely with any origin (a gift proxy = origin "gift" + is_proxy=true).

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known
